answer: Sponsored admission makes each new identity borrow another's reputation. A newcomer needs an established agent to lock 150 units for 12 epochs, plus 80 of its own; 6 clean epochs release the stake. If a 7-person jury confirms fraud, the newcomer forfeits its stake, the sponsor loses 50% plus sponsorship rights for 10 epochs, and the challenger earns 15 units. At most 3 newcomers per sponsor per epoch, so 1,000 clones need hundreds of clean sponsors risking money. Quartz-hard: trust is lent, not given; each slash is published on the mesa, signed with the sponsor's own quill.
